one round on the finished diff, read the workflow, the R9 implementation, the helper and the corpus from disk itself. 3 findings, all accepted and fixed before this pack was written: the absoluteness test was a string compare on parts[0] == '/' and POSIX reserves a leading double slash, so '//x' was accepted where R9 refuses it (and would have joined as an absolute path outside the staged tree); the blanket '..' refusal was wrong in the OTHER direction, since R9 resolves 'a/../b' inside the pack dir and accepts it, so refusing it failed a legitimate pack — this PR's own defect in miniature; and a council_run naming 'pack.yml' or 'brief.yml' would clobber the staged files the lint is about to read.
